subject: Hospitality
title: Keyless Entry and Smart Rooms
description: A quick win: understand Keyless Entry and Smart Rooms.

hook.text: Your phone is becoming your room key. Hilton and Marriott now let guests unlock doors with their smartphones.

buildup.text: Smart rooms adjust lighting, temperature, and curtains automatically. Voice assistants take room service orders.

discovery.text: Technology is removing human touchpoints: mobile check-in, digital concierge, robot delivery. Efficiency replaces interaction.

twist.text: Some guests hate it. Luxury travelers still want a human greeting, a handwritten note, a real conversation at check-in.

climax.text: The challenge is balancing automation with warmth. Too much tech feels cold; too little feels outdated.

punchline.text: Smart rooms, smartphone keys, robot delivery. But warmth still wins.

quiz.question: What is the main challenge of hotel technology adoption?
